# ViewDB

Database facade for JavaScript/TypeScript with pluggable persistence stores.

## Architecture

ViewDB -> Store -> Collection -> Cursor / Observer

- ViewDB: facade that accepts a Store (default: InMemoryStore).
- Store: .open(), .close(), .collection(name).
- Collection: .find(query), .insert(docs, cb), .save(docs, cb), .remove(query, cb), .drop(cb), .ensureIndex().
- Cursor: returned by .find(). Supports .toArray(cb), .sort(), .skip(), .limit(), .count(cb), .observe(callbacks).
- Observer: returned by .observe(). Returns { stop } handle (not this). Callbacks: init, added, changed, removed.

## Packages

- viewdb (0.12.0): Core facade, in-memory store, cursor, observer, merge utilities.
- viewdb_persistence_store_indexeddb (0.5.0): IndexedDB store for browsers.
- viewdb_persistence_store_mongodb (4.3.0): MongoDB store for server (driver v6).
- viewdb_persistence_store_remote (4.3.0): Remote store via socket.io, REST, or hybrid (local+remote).
- viewdb_persistence_store_lokijs (1.0.0): LokiJS store with partitioning and Cordova FS adapters.

## File Layout

packages/viewdb/src/                          - Core: ViewDB, InMemoryStore, Cursor, Observer, merge
packages/viewdb_persistence_store_indexeddb/src/ - IndexedDB store
packages/viewdb_persistence_store_mongodb/src/   - MongoDB store
packages/viewdb_persistence_store_remote/src/    - Remote store (socket, REST, hybrid)
packages/viewdb_persistence_store_lokijs/src/    - LokiJS store
packages/shared-types/kuery/                     - kuery type shim (only shared type)

## Technical Constraints

- CommonJS only. Core uses `export = Object.assign(ViewDB, { Cursor, Observer, merge, plugins })` pattern.
- API supports both callbacks and promises. Prefer promises for new code.
- ES2018 target, compiled from TypeScript.
- Observer constructor returns { stop }, not this. Preserved with as-any cast in implementation.
- Plugins (TimestampPlugin, VersioningPlugin) use monkey-patching. Not typed.
- kuery is the only shared type shim, located at packages/shared-types/kuery/.
- tsconfig: strict: false for lokijs store, strict: true for all others.
- npm workspaces with Turborepo. Requires npm v8+.

## Build and Test

npm install        - install all workspace dependencies
npx turbo build    - build all packages (TypeScript -> CommonJS)
npx turbo test     - run all tests

Individual package: npx turbo build --filter=viewdb
